title: ophrys umbilicata subsp. latakiana
intro: Ophrys umbilicata subsp. latakiana, commonly known as the Balkan bee orchid, is a type of orchid plant species. The Balkan bee orchid is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. This plant has been traditionally used for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and easing respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the Balkan bee orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
